description: Display response rate for a marketplace over a period, grouped by one or more caller-chosen dimensions: network, store_id, page_type, device, ad_unit, and category hierarchy (category_l1..category_l3). Returns raw ad requests, responses, and response rate (%). Pick which dimension(s) to group by via the requested attributes; all dimensions are filterable. No spend / no currency conversion.

network.description: The supply network / channel the ad request came from.

store_id.description: The store the ad request was attributed to.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

device.description: The device type the ad request came from (mobile, desktop, app, ...).

ad_unit.description: The display ad unit / placement slot the request was attributed to.

category_l1.description: Top-level (L1) product category the requests/responses were attributed to.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received for this dimension grouping.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (responses) for this dimension grouping.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = responses / requests * 100 for this dimension grouping.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_filtered_level_performance_facts` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
